text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is so hard! Have either of you had to
make an
apron in your home ec class?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I haven't yet. We've only done cooking
practice
so far.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! An apron? Us wielders of magic
have our
own clothes that are so much
better. Who needs
an apron?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how unfortunate. I was hoping one
of you
could help me decide on a
design.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's only an apron, any garb for a
princess
to wear must have a truly
elegant design... Ohhh,
what to do?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then how about adding some lace to
it?
That'd be so cute. And some frills on
the hem,
maybe!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! But, you know, it
probably
shouldn't be too puffy or
anything. It'll be used
for cooking, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh—I know! I should add some sparkly weights that look like jewels! They will add elegance and help me train—two birds, one stone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What? But wouldn't that ruin the frills?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should add holsters for some
knives and
a pot lid, too. You never
know what might
happen in the kitchen!
